title: 理科教育法Ⅰ
subtitle: Educational Methods for Science I
teachers:
KUDO Tomoshige
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this course, students will acquire basic knowledge necessary for taking science class in secondary education. This course covers the objectives of science education, the course of study “Science”, the content and teaching materials of each area in science, teaching methods and evaluation, and inquiry activity of science.
advice:
In this course, students will learn basic knowledge necessary for taking science class in secondary education as bellow.

 1. Science education: PISA, the objective, observation and experiment including safety guidance, the evaluation
 2. The course of study: the objectives and the content of each subject
 3. Overview of each area of science, instruction, teaching materials, inquiry activity and evaluation: physics, chemistry, biology, and earth science
 4. How to use ICT in science education
 5. The problems of energy and environment

Students will take lectures and discuss their significance with each other.
books:
●Takeo Samaki & Akira Yoshida(2019) Jugyou-ni-Ikasu Rika-Kyouikuhou. Toukyo-Shoseki.
●Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology(2018) The Course of Study(Science).
requiredKnowledge:
●To have basic science knowledge.
●Aim to obtain a Japanese teacher's license.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand objectives of “Science”.
Be able to understand areas of mathematics, and design science lessons.
Be able to create teaching materials and make plans of evaluation.
Be able to engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand the objective of “Science” in relation to PISA and practice an appropriate lesson.

(2) Understand the course of study with focus on scientific literacy and design a science lesson.

(3) Design an instruction, teaching materials and inquiry activity of science, and invent a science lesson taking them into account.
